_comment: Single source of truth for rooms. Copy to rooms.json and fill in. A 'room' is one agent's private scope: its cards are invisible to other rooms unless a card carries a 'share' field. Most installs want exactly one room — add more only if you run multiple agents with separate privacy scopes. room_dir: where the engine writes this room's memory files (context-last-24.md, digest.md, constants.md). project_dir: where this room's conversation logs (JSONL) accumulate — for Claude Code that is ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/. After editing, restart the watcher if it is running.
